newsitem.title: ANTIGUA: CRICKET-MURALITHARAN RUNS THROUGH WEST INDIES.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-MURALITHARAN RUNS THROUGH WEST INDIES.

text.p: Sri Lanka off-spinner Muttiah Muralitharan captured five for 34 on Saturday as West Indies were shot out for 189 in the first test.
The visitors went into their second innings 34 ahead but quickly lost Sanath Jayasuriya and reached 15 for one at tea.
Muralitharan started the second day slide when he trapped Carl Hooper leg before for 27.
Roland Holder then drove off-spinner Kumara Dharmasena's first delivery straight back to him and was out for 28.
Ian Bishop was dropped first ball off Dharmasena, before Courtney Browne, who also survived a chance, was caught by Jayasuriya at silly mid-on off Muralitharan to make the score 172 for seven.
Muralitharan ran through the tail as he bowled Bishop for five and Franklyn Rose and Courtney Walsh, both for nought.
Curtly Ambrose struck with the third ball of his first over. Jayasuriya steered a catch to Hooper at second slip without a run scored.
